材质_EN: with a lid, cylindrical shape, porcelain
AAT_keyword_ZN: 瓷;地;中国;日本;根;南;根;方
描述_EN: Chinese porcelain kakufuku is often found in Kyushu's warp mounds. It is thought that it was fired at a kiln somewhere in southern China, but this is not clear. There is also an opinion that they were ordered from Japan, based on the fact that no examples have been found in China.
描述_ZN: 中国瓷器的经筒经常在九州的经冢中被发现。 有人认为它是在中国南方的某个窑场烧制的，但这并不清楚。 也有一种观点认为它们是从日本订购的，依据是在中国没有发现任何例子。
